body:
The escape starts doing the treatment's job, badly.

Someone pours, scrolls, drifts elsewhere past bedtime, medicating the ache while relief and repair diverge another degree.

With Neptune square Chiron, people take the exit on offer while carrying the injury the exit keeps postponing.

Each night of one raises the price of the other.

The medicine may still be needed some nights, but medicating and treating are different verbs, and the people who stay honest about which one they are doing tend to keep both options usable.
